title: SensAiry (iBeacon)
notes: How the SensAiry app (com.tymtix.sensairy 2.10.07, read for interoperability on 2026-11-18) reads its newer sensors: an iBeacon frame, Apple manufacturer data (company 004C) starting 02 15. Data: A-B 0215, C-R the 16-byte UUID, S-T major, U-V minor, W tx power. For external sensors the major shifted right by 5 is kPa (shown in psi as for the Eddystone sensors) and minor byte 0 is the temperature as a signed byte in degC. For internal sensors the app reads the major as a raw pressure count and the low 12 bits of the minor as a raw temperature count (bits 5-6 of minor byte 0 are battery), and converts both with calibration data it keeps per sensor, which is not available here: then only raw_pressure and raw_temp mean anything. Which kind a sensor is, the app knows from its pairing. Whether the UUID identifies a sensor is a guess (sensorId). Marked 'inferred' until a capture from the car matches the app's readings.
